name: k10b-copilot-reuse-tiers
description: K10b: what do host-RAM and SSD KV tiers add on a real day of agent traffic? K10a's setting with sticky placement and LRU, plus per-replica lower tiers: none, 256 GB RAM, 1 TB RAM, 1 TB RAM + 4 TB SSD. Loaded tokens cost 0.03 (RAM) and 0.21 (SSD) of a recomputed one: Qwen3-4B KV over 50 GB/s and 7 GB/s against a 10k tokens/s prefill (nominal figures, assumptions; loaded shares are reported so other ratios apply).
